name: Feature Carousel
description: Animated feature-card carousel with autoplay, swipe, keyboard navigation, nav arrows and a call to action.
notes: The nine per-style transition trees moved to `primitives/animation.dart` (`AnimatedStyleTransition` + `AnimatedTransitionStyle`), a primitive named in the batch data.
`clickable` is added to `deps.primitives` (the batch listed only `animation`): the old raw `GestureDetector` arrows/CTA had no keyboard or focus; they are `Clickable` now.
The `titleBuilder`/`descriptionBuilder`/`backgroundBuilder`/`ctaBuilder` hooks are dropped (clean break): a custom card covers all of them.

The painters live in `feature_carousel_style.dart` (public, because Dart privacy is per-library) so both files stay under 400 lines. `FeatureCarouselCenterCard` / `FeatureCarouselGhostCard` are framework-internal: they exist only to share rendering between the two files and are not intended as user API.
